title: Shippo to Gekirin
synopsis: Aki Miyama is a beastkin who has lived a quiet, unassuming life, blending in seamlessly among humans. Then, one day—quite out of the blue—a beastkin child named Tsukiko suddenly tumbles into his life! Thus begins a shared existence born of a chance encounter between two polar opposites: a socially awkward adult and a guileless, earnest child. Together, they make a home—striving to survive in a world that was never built for the likes of them. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

synopsis: The original story is set a few years after dungeons began appearing in the modern world. Karin Yamada is a "dungeon streamer," a new kind of streamer who live streams their expeditions in the dungeon. Though she has adopted the character of a classy rich lady, with zero views and three subscribers, she is decidedly obscure, and depressed about it. One day, she stumbles on an adventurer trying to stir up trouble for views by causing an explosion in a dungeon. Karin immediately leaps into action and stops it by beating up the adventurer. Little did she know that the adventurer was also streaming to a wide audience, who all saw her beating up and lecturing the adventurer. The incident propels her to overnight popularity. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Shin Souta no Houchou
synopsis: Sota Kitaoka, born in Shizunai, Hokkaido, to a family that ran a restaurant called "Kitaoka", moved to Tokyo for training in order to rebuild his family's run-down restaurant. There, he was discovered by the owner of "Tomikyu," a long-established ryotei restaurant in Ginza, where he underwent rigorous training, eventually becoming the head chef at Tomikyu. After that, he went on a culinary journey until he opened his own restaurant, "Tomikyu Kamui" in Nerima, Tokyo. A few years later, Sota is back at it again, this time to pursue the essence of "Omotenashi" (hospitality), just in time for the 2020 Tokyo Olympics! The long-awaited revival of the classic culinary manga! (Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Kiku, the daughter seems to have inherited her father's boxing sense and tries to teach Ryuji to become a world contender. However, Ryuji hates boxing and gets picked on. After Kiku and Ryuji leave their hometown for Tokyo, Ryuji eventually learns to discover a passion for boxing after an encounter with a boxing prodigy, Kenzaki Jun. This will eventually lead him to learn crazy moves and out of this world opponents to become one of Japan's top junior boxers. (Source: Anime News Network)

synopsis: After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she’s not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family’s province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
